    1. applyTo(Higher2)

Schnittstelle Appliable2<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A1, A2>

Typparameter:
WT - the witness type of the implementing higher‑kinded type
A1 - the first carried type
A2 - the second carried type
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Either<L,R>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Either.Left, Either.Right, Record2, Tuple2
public interface Appliable2<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A1, A2>

Rank-2 applicative functor interface: applies functions inside the context to the two carried type parameters, producing a value of the same constructor shape.

This interface is the rank-2 analog to Haskell's Applicative functor class. Conceptually, this “applies” (A1 -> B1) to A1 and (A2 -> B2) to A2 within the same Higher2<WT, *, *> context.

Contract: the provided higher‑kinded value must not be null, must not contain null functions, and the result must not be null.

    • applyTo

      <B1,B2> @NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<WT,B1,B2> applyTo(@NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<WT, ? extends Function<? super A1, ? extends B1>, ? extends Function<? super A2, ? extends B2>> transformation)

      Applies the given functions to the two carried values in this context.

      Typparameter:
      B1 - the new first type after applying the function to A1
      B2 - the new second type after applying the function to A2
      Parameter:
      transformation - a Higher2 carrying the functions A1 -> B1 and A2 -> B2; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Higher2<WT, B1, B2> value; never null
